name: Kakao Games Corp.
summary: Kakao Games Corp. operates a mobile and PC online game service platform for gamers worldwide. The company develops and publishes various genres of games, including PC, mobile, and VR platforms. It provides mobile game services, such as kakao and snack games, mobile game play channel, play by star, and Cacao game shop; and PC online game services comprising PC/online game portal and Cacao games PC room. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Seongnam-si, South Korea.
